From: Emily Park <epark@retailco.com>

Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: Sun, 31 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: staged prompt-pack + fallback dataset for QA acceptance

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers look promising. We are preparing a short MAP to get a 2-week evaluation going next month. A couple of asks up-front to make sure our security and procurement teams can sign off quickly:

- Can you provide a staged prompt-pack (sanitized) and a small fallback/"parachute" dataset we can use for smoke QA if our prod data isn't available?
- Any constraints on usage, retention, and deletion for the testcases / promptpack? We need to map that to our vendor intake checklist.
- Target close timeline: start evaluation 2025-09-08, acceptance decision by 2025-09-22. Is that feasible on your side?

If you can share a preliminary MAP and a manifest of files you plan to ship, procurement can start the MSA/mutual NDAs in parallel.

Appreciate it,
Emily Park
Senior Product Manager — Retail AI
RetailCo

Attachment: evaluation_requirements.pdf (summary)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <epark@retailco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Sep 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staged prompt-pack + fallback dataset for QA acceptance

Emily —

Thanks for the clear timeline. We can absolutely run the 2-week MAP with the schedule you suggested. Attaching a draft MAP and the prompt-pack we propose for the sprint. A couple of notes inline:

- Staged prompt-pack: promptpack_v2.zip (sanitized examples, excludes any PII). It is intended for ephemeral use in the staging sandbox only; see usage clause #2 in the MAP.
- Parachute dataset: small synthetic corpus + edge-case labels; included as a manifest (parachute_dataset_manifest.csv). We don't ship the raw parachute files in this package — we will provide an S3 presigned URL to the secure bucket when procurement signs the short transfer addendum.
- Retention & takedown: Redwood will expire test artifacts 30 days after MAP end unless explicit extension is agreed; immediate takedown on request within 48 hours.
- Acceptance gates: functional QA (coverage checklist), latency/cost checks (per-token targets), and a small accuracy spot-check (5% failure tolerance).

Proposed milestone dates:
- 2025-09-08: MAP start, prompt-pack and manifest available in staging
- 2025-09-11: Mid-sprint sync and smoke-run report
- 2025-09-18: Final QA run and pass/fail evidence delivered
- 2025-09-22: Acceptance decision and close or next steps

I've looped in Marissa for launch ops and Karthik for the provisioning checklist.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_RetailCo_v1.pdf, promptpack_v2.zip

Thanks for the draft — quick legal/devsec signoff notes below. Emily / RetailCo: copying procurement so we have the transfer-addendum conversation in one thread.

1) Usage constraints: approved as written with one addition — no derivative-model training on the parachute dataset or prompt-pack (explicitly disallowed). Permitted: ephemeral inference and QA runs only. Please confirm you accept that clause.
2) Retention/takedown: we will enforce a 48-hour takedown SLA after written request and maintain access logs for 180 days. We can provide exportable audit logs for the sprint window.
3) Data delivery: we will provide presigned S3 objects (7-day expiry) and will rotate links if reissued. Procurement: Redwood requires the short transfer addendum signed before issuing the presigned URLs. The addendum is non-material and focuses on access controls and takedown mechanics.
4) Attachments & artifacts: promptpack_v2.zip is sanitized and flagged as "staging-only". The parachute dataset in this initial MAP is synthetic only; we will not ship any customer data.

If RetailCo is good with the no-derivatives clause, Jonas — you can mark the MAP final and I will prepare a one-page redline for procurement.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
